# Pristine Auto Detailing Arlington

> Professional auto detailing shop in Arlington, VA. Detailing division of TAB Motors.

- Address: 4035 Old Dominion Dr, Arlington, VA 22207
- Phone: (703) 964-2687
- Email: support@tabmotorsarlington.com
- Hours: Monday - Friday 7:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday Closed

## Packages
- [Express Clean](https://arlington-premier-detailing.vercel.app/services/express-clean/): $49 sedan, $69 SUV or truck, approx. 45 to 60 minutes
- [Basic Detail](https://arlington-premier-detailing.vercel.app/services/basic-detail/): $129 sedan, $159 SUV or truck, approx. 1.5 to 2.5 hours
- [Premium Full Detail](https://arlington-premier-detailing.vercel.app/services/premium-full-detail/): $249 sedan, $299 SUV or truck, approx. 3.5 to 5 hours
- [Interior Deep Detail](https://arlington-premier-detailing.vercel.app/services/interior-detail/): $149 sedan, $189 SUV or truck, approx. 1.5 to 2.5 hours
- [Exterior Detail Only](https://arlington-premier-detailing.vercel.app/services/exterior-detail/): $119 sedan, $149 SUV or truck, approx. 1 to 2 hours
